# Number Analytics

> > AI-powered statistical software providing no-code analytics, automated regression testing, and data analysis for business users across web, iOS, and Android platforms.

Number Analytics offers accessible statistical analysis tools that work with Excel, CSV, and SPSS files, enabling users to perform complex data analysis without coding expertise. The platform includes mobile analytics apps and supports spreadsheet-based workflows for business intelligence.

## Key Topics

- AI statistical analysis
- No-code analytics
- Automated statistics
- Data analysis software
- Regression testing
- Spreadsheet analysis
- Mobile analytics app
- Excel integration
- CSV analysis
- SPSS compatibility
- iOS and Android apps
- Business analytics
- Statistical software
- Automated data processing

## Core Platform

- [Number Analytics - AI Statistical Software](https://www.numberanalytics.com/): Homepage for Number Analytics AI statistical software for business analytics

## Mathematics and Statistics Guides

- [Absolute Value Inequalities Demystified](https://www.numberanalytics.com/blog/absolute-value-inequalities-guide): Pre-algebra tutorial with step-by-step solutions for inequalities
- [Congruence Transformations Techniques](https://www.numberanalytics.com/blog/congruence-transformations-techniques): Step-by-step geometry guide covering transformations and reflections

## Writing and Literary Analysis

- [7 Proven Techniques to Enhance Coherence in Your Writing](https://www.numberanalytics.com/blog/coherent-writing-techniques): Writing improvement techniques for clarity, flow, and content structure
- [Narrative Structure Essentials](https://www.numberanalytics.com/blog/narrative-structure-essentials): Beginner's guide to narrative structure and literary analysis fundamentals
- [Detachment in Modern Literature](https://www.numberanalytics.com/blog/ultimate-guide-detachment-contemporary-literature): Literary analysis of detachment in modernist fiction by Joyce, Woolf, Kafka
